name: Ka-Cheeseburger Single Patty on Plain White Bun
whyItWorks: A single fresh beef patty grilled and topped with a slice of mild American cheese on a soft bakery bun provides balanced protein and easily digested carbohydrates.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the burger plain (meat, cheese, bun only). Skip lettuce, tomato, raw onions, pickles, and 1000 Island dressing. Swap steak fries for cuties mandarin or apple slices.
